secondary_gt_unchanged: face geometry at identical ray hits
diagnostic_gt: area-weighted face-corner geometry normals; edge-connected smoothing fans split at dihedral >45 degrees; never smooth across boundary/nonmanifold edges; no material/custom normals

diagnostic crease45 GT angular jumps >20 degrees plus silhouette, radius-2 dilation, intersect identical ray-hit mask
region_reporting: inside/outside each fixed common band; count, coverage, angle sum and mean; image/asset/pixel aggregates; empty regions null with explicit counts
diagnostic_scoring_scope: crease45 is a boundary sensitivity definition, not a replacement main GT or an extra global model ranking

arb_audit_scope: all 2000 assets in the existing fixed plan, not only downloaded assets; classification failures remain unknown, never count as clean
arb_validation_sensitivity: same all-asset predictions/noise/masks; additionally aggregate only metadata-unflagged validation assets; report asset and image denominators and boundary metrics; fixed partition independent of model scores
formal_quality_rule: propose a separate asset-level rule after the complete metadata audit; do not silently apply to frozen convergence runs or auto-unlock the formal grid
